summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder did not authorise the 29 April 2025 charge of GBP 87.40 at QuickStream Digital, that the card was in the cardholder's possession, and that the cardholder has no relationship with the merchant.
summary.to_defend: Mastercard requires any two of: full AVS plus CVV match, successful 3D Secure authentication, two prior undisputed transactions with matching billing details, or signed proof of delivery to the billing address.

requirements.title: AVS and CVV match
requirements.text: AVS match (full address) AND CVV match on the disputed transaction.
requirements.finding: Transaction metadata shows avs_result N and cvv_result N, so neither the address nor the security code matched on the disputed transaction.
requirements.gap: No address or CVV match exists; the checks were run and both failed.

requirements.title: 3DS authenticated
requirements.text: 3D Secure authentication completed successfully (Mastercard SecureCode / Identity Check).
requirements.finding: The transaction carries three_ds_status of not_attempted, so no Mastercard Identity Check authentication was performed.
requirements.gap: 3D Secure was never attempted and cannot be created after the fact.

requirements.title: Two prior undisputed transactions
requirements.text: Two prior undisputed transactions from the same cardholder with this merchant in the past 12 months, with matching billing details.
requirements.finding: The merchant's own report records the customer account as new with a single transaction in the last 24 hours, so there is no history of prior undisputed transactions.
requirements.gap: No prior transaction history with matching billing details exists for this cardholder.

requirements.title: Signed delivery to billing address
requirements.text: Proof of delivery to the cardholder's billing address with signature.
requirements.finding: This is a digital goods purchase under MCC 5815 with no shipping address recorded, so signed physical delivery to the billing address cannot apply.

documents.label: Merchant internal fraud screening report
documents.reason: It is the merchant's own risk opinion generated after the chargeback; it contains no AVS, CVV, 3DS, transaction history or delivery evidence meeting any requirement, and it confirms the buyer was a first time customer.

alerts.text: The merchant's fraud report concludes the transaction is legitimate and low risk, but it does not address that AVS returned N, CVV returned N, 3D Secure was not attempted, and the device fingerprint was new and unseen at 03:42 UTC.

reasons: Every requirement the decision relies on is backed by verified evidence
notes: Conflicting evidence flagged; it does not make accepting riskier

justification: No requirement is satisfied and the two decisive ones, authentication and card verification, failed on the transaction itself and cannot be remedied.
rationale:
The issuer alleges the cardholder did not authorise the GBP 87.40 charge on 29 April 2025 (txn_7762GH) and has no relationship with QuickStream Digital.
AVS returned N and CVV returned N, and 3D Secure was not attempted, so neither of the authentication based requirements can be met.
The merchant's own screening report confirms this was a first transaction from a new account, so there are no two prior undisputed transactions with matching billing details.
The purchase is digital goods under MCC 5815 with no shipping address, so signed proof of delivery to the billing address does not apply.
With zero of the required two conditions met and the failures fixed in the transaction record, the chargeback should be accepted.
